_README: COPY THIS to documents/<id>.json. One file per filing, announcement, government release or article. This is what the AI cites — the snippet shown on screen comes from chunks[].text, so make the text accurate and quotable.
title: Union Budget 2026-27: Defence allocation raised
_tier: official = PIB/SEBI/RBI/Budget/exchange circulars | filing = company announcements, results, investor presentations | press = ET/Mint/BS/BusinessLine/Moneycontrol | market_data = prices, ratios, bhavcopy, screener | social = social media. We ingest social ONLY so the AI can argue against it, never as evidence.
_tickers: Which of our covered companies this touches. Drives retrieval — get this right or the document will never be found.
_text: Full plain text. For NSE/BSE announcements, attchmntText gives you this directly — no PDF parsing needed.
text: Full plain text of the document goes here.
_chunks: Split text into ~500-token pieces. For short documents, one chunk holding the whole text is fine. chunk.text is what gets embedded AND what the user sees as the quoted snippet.
